zh: 只保留的箱子由其中最小值和最大值决定是否合法；一旦最小、最大值固定，夹在它们之间的所有箱子都可以一起保留。
所以最优保留集合可以取成排序后的一个连续窗口，问题变成求满足 最大值 ≤ capacity × 最小值 的最长连续窗口。
尺寸升序排序；右端逐个右移，若当前右端大于 capacity 乘左端就不断右移左端；每步用窗口长度更新最大值；答案为 n 减最长窗口长度。乘积可达 5×10^14，用 64 位整数。
en: Whether the kept boxes are valid depends only on their minimum and maximum; once those are fixed, every box in between can be kept as well.
So an optimal kept set can be taken as a contiguous window of the sorted sizes, and the task becomes finding the longest window with maximum <= capacity times minimum.

Sort the sizes ascending; advance the right end one by one, and while the right value exceeds capacity times the left value, move the left end right; update the best window length each step; the answer is n minus the longest length. The product can reach 5*10^14, so use 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Sort, then use two pointers to keep the maximum at most capacity times the minimum, maximizing the window length.

## Proof of correctness

Once the minimum and maximum of the kept set are fixed, every box between them can be kept without breaking the condition, so some optimal solution is a contiguous window of the sorted order. As the right end increases, the left end is moved until the condition holds; this gives the longest valid window for the current right end, and taking the maximum covers every possible optimum.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(n).
